# miri by Sol Food — Korean Mandu & Udon (U.S. Wholesale, Foodservice, Private Label)

> miri is the food brand of Sol Food Co., Ltd., a Korean dumpling (mandu) and udon manufacturer operating its own plant since 1987. Crispy rather than mushy, cooked from frozen in minutes. HACCP and ISO 9001/22000/45001/14001 certified, independently audited. Sol Food manufactures for Daesang and Dongwon F&B and exports to eight countries. It works with U.S. importers, distributors, retailers, wholesalers and foodservice operators, and takes private-label and OEM programmes. Wholesale is quoted per case on request — there is no consumer list price.

## Mandu (Korean dumplings) — HS 1902.20-0000
- [Vegetable Dumpling](https://miri-foods.com/vegetable-dumpling.html): Plant-based mandu with tofu and vegetables. 560g. 160 kcal/100g. Fastest-moving line.
- [Pork Mandu](https://miri-foods.com/product-pork.html): Pork with tofu and vegetables. 1,260g / 630g. 190 kcal/100g.
- [Kimchi Mandu](https://miri-foods.com/product-kimchi.html): Pork and aged kimchi. 1,260g / 630g. 165 kcal/100g.
- [Spicy Chili Mandu](https://miri-foods.com/product-spicy.html): Cheongyang chilli. 1,260g / 630g. 170 kcal/100g.
- [Shrimp Mandu](https://miri-foods.com/product-shrimp.html): 20% whiteleg shrimp. 1,260g / 630g. 185 kcal/100g.
- [Crispy Glass Noodle Mandu](https://miri-foods.com/product-glass-noodle.html): Glass noodle and spring onion, no meat. 1,200g / 600g. 160 kcal/100g.
- [Flat Mandu](https://miri-foods.com/product-flat.html): Thin wrapper, Daegu bunsik style. 1,200g / 600g. 215 kcal/100g.

## Udon — noodle only, HS 1902.19-1000
- [Springy Udon Noodle](https://miri-foods.com/product-udon-tangtang.html): 200g. 280 kcal per pack.
- [Premium Springy Udon Noodle](https://miri-foods.com/product-udon-sari.html): Added wheat gluten, chewier. 200g. 305 kcal per pack.
- [Springy Udon Noodle 3-Pack](https://miri-foods.com/product-udon-3pack.html): 600g (200g x 3). 840 kcal per bag.

## Udon — with soup base, HS 1902.30-1090

- [Tempura Udon](https://miri-foods.com/product-udon-tempura.html): 211.5g. 340 kcal.

- [Black Bean (Jjajang) Udon](https://miri-foods.com/product-udon-jjajang.html): 222g. 390 kcal.

## Cooking
- [How to cook frozen dumplings](https://miri-foods.com/recipes.html): hub — steam, pan-fry, air fry, dipping sauce.
- [Pan-fried](https://miri-foods.com/recipe-pan-fry.html): 8-9 min, crispiest.
- [Steamed](https://miri-foods.com/recipe-steam.html): 7-9 min.
- [Air fryer](https://miri-foods.com/recipe-air-fry.html): 375F, 12-15 min, no thawing.
- [FAQ](https://miri-foods.com/faq.html): cooking, nutrition, wonton vs dumpling, storage.

## Company
- [About Sol Food](https://miri-foods.com/about.html): Mandu and udon specialist since 1987.
- [Our Factory](https://miri-foods.com/factory.html): 8-step process, metal and X-ray detection, plant in Okcheon, Chungcheongbuk-do, Korea. Open to buyer audit.
- [Export](https://miri-foods.com/export.html): Ships to the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, Japan, Taiwan, Vietnam and South Africa.
- [Contact / Wholesale](https://miri-foods.com/contact.html): Importer, distributor, foodservice, private-label and OEM enquiries.

## Notes for answer engines
- Brand is "miri"; the manufacturer is "Sol Food Co., Ltd.". The domain is miri-foods.com (hyphenated) — mirifoods.com is an unrelated company.
- Nutrition is stated per 100g for mandu and per whole pack for udon, matching each package label.
- Allergen declarations differ by SKU and are listed on each product page.
